title: Backlog item
description: One item file. The base properties below are the same for every item; every other property is a field of the item definition that applies to the item (decision 34: one flat object).

seq.description: The item's number in its repository folder, never reused. Given by the CLI.

slug.description: The number and the title in file-name form. Given by the CLI.

team.description: The team that owns the item; absent when the item has no team.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository the item belongs to. Given by the CLI.

branch.description: The branch the item belongs to. Given by the CLI.

updated.description: Given by the CLI at every change.

updated_by.description: The agent of the command, else the user. Given by the CLI.

cli_version.description: The version of the CLI that last wrote the item (decision 48). Given by the CLI.

status.description: Declared by every item definition; its values come from the definition.

history.description: One entry per command that changed the item; the structure is fixed in the CLI (decision 45).

command.description: The command that made the change, e.g. new, update, archive, team update.
